title: Among Us: Adversarially Robust Collaborative Perception by Consensus
problem: Defend collaborative 3D detection against unseen adversarial teammates

metrics_result: Detection AP under attack; abstract states validation on collaborative 3D detection, no single headline number in abstract
limitation_gap: Single-frame consensus; assumes attackers are a minority; perception features, not kinematic beacons
relevance_why: Consensus-among-agents defence is the CP analogue of cross-identity checks for Sybil; transferable idea for BSM trajectories
multi_agent: Connected vehicles / robots sharing intermediate perception features; some teammates adversarial

title: On Data Fabrication in Collaborative Vehicular Perception: Attacks and Countermeasures
